name: What is remodel plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodel plumbing involves modifying existing plumbing systems during a renovation project. This can include moving or adding new fixtures like sinks, toilets, showers, or bathtubs, re-routing water supply lines and drainpipes, or upgrading to more efficient systems. It ensures the plumbing infrastructure supports the new layout and functionality of your remodeled space, whether it's a kitchen, bathroom, or an entire home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel plumbing modifies existing plumbing systems during renovations, often involving moving or adding fixtures and re-routing pipes.
